headline: Macrophage and smooth muscle states define human atherosclerotic plaque remodeling
label: Single Cell Disease Signatures
summary: Single-cell states are increasingly paired with bulk cohorts, genetic evidence, and spatial profiling to define disease programs.
synthesis: The dominant thread is single-cell state resolution in vascular and inflammatory disease. The atherosclerosis study integrates scRNA-seq (GSE260657) with bulk GSE28829 to map inflammatory macrophage states and a VSMC remodeling continuum. Other items pair cell-type-specific layers with additional evidence: the PFOA study combines single-cell data and Mendelian randomization with HL-1 assays to prioritize complement factor B, the PAD kaempferol study links macrophage polarization to ferroptosis, and the fracture nonunion article applies spatial multi-omics to immune-vascular-skeletal crosstalk. The newer element is coupling single-cell states to genetic evidence and spatial context. Remaining items, including Moyamoya and post-COVID serum proteomics and AVF biomarker profiling, rely on bulk measurements, while the diabetic wound CNP-miR146a and C-HDL valve studies are primarily mechanistic.
